title: Ericsson and Beyon mark sustainability milestones with extended collaboration
summary: Beyon and Ericsson extend sustainability Memorandum of Understanding to build on achievements and accelerate further environmental progress The collaboration has delivered measurable gains in energy efficiency and circularity, including recycling 54 metric tons of e-waste through Ericsson’s E-Waste program.
body_markdown:
- Beyon and Ericsson extend sustainability Memorandum of Understanding to build on achievements and accelerate further environmental progress
- The collaboration has delivered measurable gains in energy efficiency and circularity, including recycling 54 metric tons of e-waste through Ericsson’s E-Waste program.
